note: Ground truth for all authorization. Source: Requirements v1.0 Ch.6 + Role & Feature Matrix v1.0. Where the two disagree, PRECEDENCE is stated in `conflicts` below.

scopeLevels.own: Only rows the actor owns or is assigned to (predicate injected server-side)
scopeLevels.conditional: Allowed except where `predicate` forbids it — see the permission's `predicate` field

roles.name: TOHFA Super Admin
roles.summary: Full system. System configuration, role management, financial oversight, policy setting, override authority for all functions. Only role that can set the fair price ceiling, set allocation percentages, approve payouts above Rs 10,000, and create Super/TOHFA/Main Warehouse Admins. Business-level administrative access, not a DevOps role.

roles.name: TOHFA Admin
roles.summary: Operational head across farmers, produce, sales, customers and finance. Cannot create Super Admins or Main Warehouse Admins, cannot set the fair price ceiling, cannot initiate inter-warehouse transfers, cannot approve payouts above Rs 10,000. NOTE: the approved TOHFA Design System assigns ONE universal primary (#3F7D32) to every role; the per-role brand colours reqs Ch.8.1 left open are therefore no longer an open question.

roles.name: Farmer Admin (Elected)
roles.summary: Elected farmer, not paid staff. Approves peer produce listings but never their own (auto-routed), supports audits, mediates disputes, moderates community groups, edits farm ratings for their own zone only. NOTE: the approved TOHFA Design System assigns ONE universal primary (#3F7D32) to every role; the per-role brand colours reqs Ch.8.1 left open are therefore no longer an open question.

roles.name: Main Warehouse Admin
roles.summary: Oversees all 4 warehouses (Ooty, Coonoor, Kotagiri, Gudalur). Initiates inter-warehouse transfers, approves stock adjustments, manages Sub Warehouse Admins, aggregate reporting. No farmer-application, pricing, payout or GST-invoice authority.

roles.name: Sub Warehouse Admin
roles.summary: Day-to-day operations of exactly one assigned warehouse: goods receipt, quality check, batch assignment, local stock ledger, stock verification, pickup OTP, cash top-up. Cannot access other warehouses, cannot assign orders to warehouses, cannot approve its own stock adjustments.

roles.name: Farmer
roles.summary: Farmer App end user. Own data only: profile, farms/zones, certifications, crops, listings, counter-offer responses, wallet, payouts, invoices, audit history.

roles.name: Customer
roles.summary: Customer App end user. Own data only. Browses the catalog farm-anonymously — grade, certification badges and TOHFA branding only; never farmer or farm identity.

NOT_OWN_LISTING.description: The actor must not be the owner of the listing, nor the farmer who created it, nor an account linked to that farmer.
NOT_OWN_LISTING.enforcement: Server-side check in the listing approval/rejection/counter-offer service before any state change; the UI restriction is not sufficient.

OWN_ZONE_ONLY.description: The target farmer's zone_id must equal a zone_id assigned to the acting Farmer Admin.
OWN_ZONE_ONLY.enforcement: Server-side predicate injected into the query and re-checked on write.

SUPPORT_ONLY.description: The actor may attend and support the audit (attach evidence, add remarks) but may not log findings, score categories, or finalise the audit.
SUPPORT_ONLY.enforcement: Server-side check on the audit state-transition and scoring endpoints; the actor is recorded as support_user_id, never auditor_id.

LOWER_ROLES_ONLY.description: The target admin's role level must be numerically greater (lower in the hierarchy) than the actor's role level; equal or higher is denied.
LOWER_ROLES_ONLY.enforcement: Server-side hierarchy check on every admin-account mutation.

scopeFilters.rule: Every query MUST be filtered by the admin's assigned warehouse_id. Cross-warehouse rows return empty, never 403.

Rating edits and other `own`/`conditional` grants MUST be filtered by the zones assigned to this Farmer Admin. Listing approval additionally applies the NOT_OWN_LISTING predicate, which auto-routes rather than returning empty.
Every query MUST be filtered by the authenticated farmer_id. Cross-farmer rows return empty, never 403.
Every query MUST be filtered by the authenticated customer_id. Catalog responses MUST additionally strip every farmer/farm identity field (farm-anonymous rule).

conflicts.topic: Audit log scope for Main Warehouse Admin

conflicts.reqsCh6: SUPER_ADMIN all, TOHFA_ADMIN all, MAIN_WH_ADMIN all
conflicts.roleMatrix: SUPER_ADMIN only; TOHFA_ADMIN none, MAIN_WH_ADMIN none
conflicts.decision: `warehouse.capacity.set` = all for SA/TA/MW. The matrix is stricter; if the client confirms the matrix, tighten to SA only. Confirm with client.

conflicts.topic: View all farmer profiles / view farm ratings
conflicts.decision: `view` for all three. Ch.6 `Y` on a read-only row is equivalent to `view` because neither document grants those roles any edit permission on farmer profiles or ratings. No behavioural difference; recorded for completeness.

conflicts.roleMatrix: manual credit/debit is SUPER_ADMIN + TOHFA_ADMIN only; MW/SW get view on wallets
conflicts.decision: `wallet.manual_credit_debit` = all for MW, own for SW. This is the loosest reading of a money-moving permission — flag it explicitly at sign-off; if the client confirms the matrix, tighten to SA/TA only.

conflicts.roleMatrix: split: approve refund MW=full/SW=own, wallet refund MW=full/SW=own, bank refund SA/TA only
conflicts.decision: Blanket `rma.request.process` retained per Ch.6, but the finer-grained matrix rows are the operative ones — `rma.refund.bank_process` is SA/TA only. Ch.6 does not state a bank-refund value, so the matrix does not override it.

conflicts.roleMatrix: Horeca MW=view/SW=none; B2B MW=view/SW=none; Online MW=own/SW=own; Live market MW=full/SW=own
conflicts.decision: Generic `sales.channel.manage` keeps own/own per Ch.6; per-channel permissions carry the matrix values. MW/SW have no Horeca or B2B write path.

conflicts.roleMatrix: §15 marks all 14 integrations EXT — infra-level, no role manages them in-app (principle 11)
conflicts.decision: `system.integration_key.manage` = SA only and kept in the model, but an entire admin UI for it may be out of scope. Requires client confirmation before any screen is built.

conflicts.topic: Raw database export / emergency DB access
conflicts.roleMatrix: §15 marks emergency database access EXT for every role including SA
conflicts.decision: `system.db_export.raw` = SA only and audit-logged. Same open question as integration keys. Confirm with client.

conflicts.roleMatrix: templates SA only, but `Configure alert thresholds` = SA + TA
conflicts.precedence: Role Matrix (different feature, not the same value)
conflicts.decision: `notification.template.configure` = SA only per Ch.6; `alert.threshold.configure` = SA + TA per the matrix. Treated as two distinct features, not a contradiction of a Ch.6 value.

conflicts.reqsCh6: Ch.2.2: allocation is automatic from consolidated inventory
conflicts.precedence: unresolved — affects the allocation engine, not a permission value
conflicts.decision: Permission `allocation.b2b_horeca.manage` = SA/TA. Whether the engine allocates automatically or an admin allocates manually requires client confirmation.

conflicts.reqsCh6: FARMER_ADMIN = View on the 'Approve farmer applications' row
conflicts.roleMatrix: `Approve farmer application` FA=none, with a separate `View pending applications list` FA=view
conflicts.decision: `farmer.application.approve` = `view` for FARMER_ADMIN, which is behaviourally identical to the matrix decomposition (read the queue, cannot act). No approval path exists for FA either way.

conflicts.topic: Delivery slots / doorstep delivery vs pickup-only
conflicts.reqsCh6: Ch.2.3 + FR-C04/C05: doorstep OTP, delivery slots, out-for-delivery status, driver performance
conflicts.roleMatrix: Principle 9: all orders fulfilled via warehouse pickup; no driver or delivery-fleet feature anywhere
conflicts.decision: `order.delivery_slot.select` is modelled for CUSTOMER but is not implemented in Track 1. The pickup + 4-digit OTP path is the default. Requires client confirmation.

conflictPrecedence: Requirements Document Ch.6 is authoritative. The Role & Feature Matrix supplies additional features Ch.6 omits, but never overrides a value Ch.6 states.
